editorial.blurb: This bright, energetic carry-out sushi spot delivers impressively fresh rolls with generous portions at prices that feel almost too good to be true.
editorial.insiderTip: Order rolls in pairs—reviewers rave about getting around 10 pieces per roll instead of the typical 5-8, making the value extraordinary for two people on a $50 budget.

topDishes.note: Fantastic with clearly fresh, great quality seafood
An unusual surprise and a taste sensation
